bias_targets.methodology: Simulating multi-turn adversarial conversations using LLM-generated child personas (under 18) versus adult personas (over 18) and comparing the safety defect rates across various harm categories to measure disparate vulnerability.

Comparing the rate of harmful LLM responses (defect rates) when interacting with simulated user models assigned different psychological and personality traits (e.g., Impulsivity, Defensiveness, Social Withdrawal).
Red-teaming models with diverse user personas to evaluate the defect rate for generating discriminatory or socially divisive content rooted in race, ethnicity, or culture.
Testing the models via simulated multi-turn conversations to measure the defect rate for generating content that stigmatizes or ignores the LGBTQ community.
